title: Home Comfort Financing Fixed-Rate Interest — Account-Age Relief Schedule
content:
**Schedule.** On Home Comfort Financing fixed-rate accounts, the fixed-rate account-age relief is 10 percent when the account funded at least 36 whole months before the date of handling, 5 percent when it funded at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months before, and zero when it funded fewer than 12 whole months before.

| Account age at the date of handling (whole months since the funded date) | Relief |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 10 percent |
| from 12 up to 35 | 5 percent |
| under 12 | zero |

The account-age relief is one of the fixed-rate reliefs. The fixed-rate charging rate is the starting rate reduced once by the fixed-rate reliefs added together, never one after another.

**Example (hypothetical).** A 144-Month 9.99% APR account funded 38 whole months before the date of handling, starting rate 9.99 percent. If its fixed-rate reliefs were this 10 percent and a further 15 percent, the total of 25 percent gives 9.99 multiplied by 75 and divided by 100: 7.4925 percent.

**Boundaries.** 11 whole months: zero; 12: 5 percent. 35 whole months: 5 percent; 36: 10 percent.
